title: Render preset source profiles, family roots and complete selected writer bodies
scope: Independent selected canonical DXF RenderSettings source profiles and physical correspondence, actual preset-family named roots and original LAYOUT mode5 target binding; complete selected typed writer bodies and captured-replay edit refusal. Full rendering/native/live/output qualification stays open.

sources.title: Autodesk RAPIDRTRENDERSETTINGS DXF group codes
sources.finding: Modern common body, optional predefined flag and eight-field RapidRT derived order. This is a DXF schema, not a DWG layout claim.

sources.title: Autodesk MENTALRAYRENDERSETTINGS DXF group codes
sources.finding: Legacy class1 body uses numeric texture sampling quality and omits modern description/index/flag fields. Retained MentalRay data differs from current rendering availability.

sources.title: Autodesk Advanced Rendering
sources.finding: RapidRT and MentalRay have different named roots and incompatible settings. Common or derived RenderSettings instances define presets. Active/global roots are separate scope.

sources.title: Autodesk viewport render-preset example
sources.finding: Current example uses the RapidRT root; older plotting-root replay stays a deliberate compatibility path, without conflating engine families.
Peer schema facts expose the revision2 MentalRay terminal Boolean/real and an alternative derived RapidRT predefined flag position. Implementation code is independently authored; no GPL3 code copied.

In-memory inspection witnesses a modern common body and MentalRay revision2 with terminal290/40. No drawing bytes/values, derivative or reconstructable fixture is committed. This external observation cannot promote support and is not an ezdxf typed rendering implementation claim.

sources.title: Autodesk VIEWPORT DXF table
sources.finding: The documented shade wire table stops at0..3 while SDK examples describe named modes4/5. Keep VIEWPORT shade source proof unavailable pending an actual wire witness/spec reconciliation.

implementation: Add an independent RenderSettings audit with explicit field sequences and scoped identity/application/reactor/extension/XDATA roles. It does not use production decoder/writer profile selectors or positional tables.
Bind physical fields, immutable actual paired models, scalar vector order, named projection, class revision and flag presence to retained original source context.

Index actual preset-family roots and dictionary membership once per dictionary; enforce unique keys/targets, engine family and owner330. Extend original LAYOUT mode5 dependencies only when the preset source and actual named target match.

Extend common and MentalRay typed writer profiles, including the complete revision2 tail. Decode the optional RapidRT predefined flag only after the complete derived sequence, keeping absent/false distinct and emitting canonical common-body order.

Validate converter export against actual roots and captured immutable replay. Refuse edited live models/carriers before destination publication instead of silently discarding changes; full edited rewriting is still open.
Keep existing public model/facade/source-view layouts, callback slots and native DWG reader/parser bytes unchanged.

controls.faultSchedule: Two actual finalizer profiles, ASCII and binary, long authored names/descriptions. Retain old success; reject reuse after failure/replacement. Finite offsets0..255; stop after two consecutive unreached offsets; correct and rejoin every attempt.

development: Initial new test compile failed -Wmisleading-indentation; split the increment into its own statement line and preserve -Werror. Corrected build and owning cohorts pass.
Replace the obsolete negative root test with an actual engine mismatch. RapidRT named roots are valid and distinct from MentalRay roots.
Owning five-test cohort passes after quota/fault controls; prior four-test and six-test focused cohorts remain recorded.
Do not add external drawings or derived fixture data. New literal recipes are authored from scratch; peer drawing inspection remains external-only advisory.
limits: Complete selected body/source equality and original rooted dependencies do not establish rendering semantics, native DWG layout, full producer/version coverage, all extensions or live/emitted/whole-document ownership.
Canonical common/RapidRT and selected legacy/modern MentalRay shapes only. Active/global/environment roots, unqualified aliases and other producer variants remain open.
Raw replay edit refusal does not implement edited typed rewriting. Existing uncaptured/manual fallback behavior remains; this guard is scoped to available immutable actual replay.

Typed writer controls use same-library readback and reviewed independent schema facts. An independent emitted-field/value audit and semantic/native reader are still needed for broader writer/output qualification.
Finite allocation schedules and logical retained byte/work limits are not exhaustive allocation, RSS, formal ABI, native application or controlled performance proof.
Clean archive inclusion is checked, but legacy source-release inventory/build and omitted CMake test helpers still need repair.

Nine resource families, ATTDEF rawTypedMatched=false, ledger CLOSED, full owner/recursive/output flags false. J256/J260/J268/J284/J293/J295 stay DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; native Linux/Windows FreeCAD and independent ACIS/ACDS semantic/kernel qualification remain NOT_RUN.
next: Complete independent optional/absent/alias/extension rendering variants and active/global/environment/background/live-section/sun. Obtain actual wire evidence before VIEWPORT shade4/5 qualification; complete clipping/overrides.
Complete remaining owner/name/application/XDATA/HEADER dependencies and recursive/coupled/whole-document ownership; validate edits/remapping/emitted bytes and raw-carrier refusal/retry.
Finish TABLE Values/multiple-content/linked-data/format semantics and full native B2b/B3/C bit/schema/owner/version/corpus obligations.
Resolve recorded42-file release inventory gap and omitted helpers; qualify extracted-source build, consumers, controlled memory/performance, native FreeCAD and independent ACIS/ACDS evidence.

Continue fast owning checks and incremental targets, freeze compiled inputs before final builds/package/normal/ASan qualification, self-update/commit/report without importing external drawing derivatives.
